mostFrequentBucketCount.description: Number of points in the guessed grain

effectiveStart.description:
Effective range is calculated this way:

if date range is specified (!=null) and LeadingandTrailingGaps == true then effective range is range

else if range is specified and trailingGaps==false then it is intersection of TS range with the date range

else it is TS range

nonCoveredTime.description: total length of gap in seconds

effectiveNonCoveredRange.description: Percentage of effective range not covered by TS intervals

nonCoveredRange.description: Non-covered range: it is percentage of time series range (without imposed time range) not covered by TS intervals

countGapIntervals.description: Number of gaps in the guessed grain
